chapterTitle: Chapter 12 Structure Determination: Mass Spectrometry and Infrared Spectroscopy
title: Problem 12-3

pages.text: PROBLEM 12-3 What are the masses of the charged fragments produced in the following cleavage pathways? (a) Alpha cleavage of 2-pentanone (CH3COCH2CH2CH3) (b) Dehydration of cyclohexanol (hydroxycyclohexane) (c) McLafferty rearrangement of 4-methyl-2-pentanone [CH3COCH2CH(CH3)2] (d) Alpha cleavage of triethylamine [(CH3CH2)3N]
